title: Retail Marketing Executive
description:
**Retail Marketing executive**

**Work Location: Mysore, Karnataka**

**Job Type: Full-time**

**Job Description:**

**Winheels** is looking for enthusiastic and dedicated Marketing Staff to join our team in Mysore.

**Responsibilities:**

* Promote and market **Winheels** footwear products.
* Build and maintain good relationships with retailers and customers.
* Visit retail shops and introduce our products.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential customers.
* Support sales and marketing activities in the assigned area.

**Requirements:**

* Must be fluent in the local language **(Kannada).**
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic marketing and sales knowledge.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned area.
* Previous marketing or sales experience is preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
